definition: City neighborhood label reported by the source.
interpretation_warning: Not spatially recomputed against a boundary vintage.

definition: Community Redevelopment Area label reported by the source.
null_meaning: Blank means outside a reported CRA or unavailable; these are not distinguishable.
interpretation_warning: Blank must not automatically be interpreted as outside all CRAs.

definition: City Council district reported by the source.
interpretation_warning: District boundaries and assignments can change.

definition: Date associated with the reported status or last status update.
interpretation_warning: Not a completion date unless explicitly supported by status.

definition: Planned capital-project start date reported by the source.
null_meaning: Blank means unavailable or not applicable.
interpretation_warning: Planned dates may change and do not show actual starts.

definition: Planned capital-project end date reported by the source.
null_meaning: Blank means unavailable or not applicable.
interpretation_warning: Planned dates may change and do not show completion.

definition: Latest update date exposed by the contributing source record.
interpretation_warning: Does not identify which attribute changed.

definition: New-construction square footage reported in the permit source.
interpretation_warning: Not independently verified; may not cover additions or all sources consistently.

definition: Reported or assigned housing-unit count.
source_field_or_derivation: NBROFUNITS; single-family layer assigns one unit.
interpretation_warning: Single-family assignment is a rule, and values are not completion counts.

definition: Estimated project cost reported for City capital projects.
interpretation_warning: Not available for most private permits and not comparable to realized expenditure.

definition: Actual project cost value reported by the City capital-project viewer.
null_meaning: Blank means unavailable; source zeros may also mean unavailable.
interpretation_warning: Only a small number of rows are nonzero; do not sum as total local investment.

definition: Capital-project funding description reported by the source.
null_meaning: Blank means unavailable or not applicable.
interpretation_warning: Categories are not standardized.

definition: Indicator that the activity is a City capital project.
null_meaning: Blank means not classified by this field, not necessarily private.
interpretation_warning: Blank must not be interpreted as privately financed.

definition: Rule-based flag for activities potentially involving physical construction or demolition.
interpretation_warning: Candidate status is not proof that work occurred.

definition: Public record or project-detail URL supplied by the source, when available.
null_meaning: Blank means no record-level URL was supplied.
interpretation_warning: A URL may later move or expire.

definition: Stable identifier for one normalized activity record; not a guaranteed master-project identifier.
source_field_or_derivation: SHA-1-derived token from source family and native ID; invalid native IDs are isolated by source object.
interpretation_warning: Several activities may belong to one real development.

definition: Date the source record was created, where available.
null_meaning: Blank means unavailable or an invalid sentinel date was removed.
source_field_or_derivation: Source creation date restricted to plausible years.
interpretation_warning: Not necessarily the application or construction date.

definition: Application/opened date only where the source field supports that interpretation.
null_meaning: Blank means unavailable or unsupported for that source.
source_field_or_derivation: Source opened/application date restricted to plausible years.
interpretation_warning: Meanings still differ across source systems.

definition: Count of source features consolidated into this normalized activity.
source_field_or_derivation: Count of linked source records sharing activity_id.
interpretation_warning: A count greater than one does not prove duplicate source records.

definition: Count of distinct nonblank source geometries linked to the activity.
null_meaning: Zero means no nonblank preserved geometry.
source_field_or_derivation: Count of distinct geometry_geojson values by activity_id.
interpretation_warning: Repeated identical geometries count once.

definition: Semicolon-delimited folio identifiers from matched City building-footprint records.
null_meaning: Blank means no folio-bearing City building match.
interpretation_warning: A spatial/address match is not a legal parcel join.

definition: Number of distinct City building-footprint objects matched to the activity.
interpretation_warning: Count depends on match rules and current footprint snapshot.

definition: Minimum assessed year built among matched City building footprints.
interpretation_warning: Assessment year can lag or represent an earlier structure.

definition: Maximum assessed year built among matched City building footprints.
interpretation_warning: Assessment year can lag or represent an earlier structure.

definition: Highest configured confidence among City building-footprint matches.
source_field_or_derivation: Maximum of match_confidence using high > medium.
interpretation_warning: Confidence is rule-based and awaits manual accuracy measurement.

definition: Legacy activity-level evidence grade retained for compatibility; use activity_truth_status.verification_grade.
source_field_or_derivation: Conservative status rules; footprint and closeout signals cannot exceed D.
interpretation_warning: This field does not establish completion.

definition: Deprecated legacy realization flag; deliberately unpopulated in v0.5.
source_field_or_derivation: No longer assigned from footprint year or capital closeout.
interpretation_warning: Use explicit truth outcomes and qualifying events instead.

definition: Machine-readable reason for the legacy evidence grade.
interpretation_warning: Footprint/year and closeout bases are supporting evidence only.

definition: Semicolon-delimited source layers contributing to the normalized activity.
source_field_or_derivation: Distinct source names linked by activity_id.
valid_values: Named source layers separated by semicolons.
interpretation_warning: Membership does not establish completeness.

definition: Native public record or project identifier supplied by the source, when available.
null_meaning: Blank means the source supplied no usable native identifier.
interpretation_warning: May be reused or missing in source data.

definition: Normalized procedural stage inferred from official status text and source type.
valid_values: preconstruction_or_unknown; planning_review; permit_or_funding_approved; construction_or_inspection; completed_or_closeout; inactive
interpretation_warning: A procedural stage does not prove physical completion.

definition: Status text reported by the source at retrieval.
interpretation_warning: Status semantics differ across sources.

definition: Latitude of the point feature or arithmetic centroid of the preserved source geometry.
source_field_or_derivation: Point coordinate or average of geometry vertices.
interpretation_warning: Vertex-average centroids can fall outside complex line/polygon features.

definition: Longitude of the point feature or arithmetic centroid of the preserved source geometry.
source_field_or_derivation: Point coordinate or average of geometry vertices.
interpretation_warning: Vertex-average centroids can fall outside complex line/polygon features.

definition: Official ArcGIS service endpoint used to retrieve the contributing record.
interpretation_warning: Endpoint contents can change after the snapshot date.

definition: UTC timestamp when the source snapshot was assembled.
interpretation_warning: This is retrieval time, not activity time.

definition: Project or application name as reported by the source.
interpretation_warning: Names are not standardized across layers.

definition: Free-text project description reported by the source.
interpretation_warning: May be incomplete or use administrative language.

definition: Normalized broad category assigned from source layer, record type, description, and reported square footage.
valid_values: building_construction; demolition; other_permitted_work; planning_application; historic_preservation_application; public_capital:*; single_family_new_construction_or_addition
interpretation_warning: Classification has not yet been manually accuracy-tested.

definition: Permit, application, capital-project, or preservation record type reported by the source.

definition: Site address reported by the source.
